shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cd /workspace && node server.js > /tmp/book-app.log 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; sleep 1; echo "Server PID: $SERVER_PID"; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | head -n 20; curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books -d '"'title=The%20Hobbit&author=J.R.R.%20Tolkien&notes=Fun%20read' -i | head -n 20; BOOK_ID="'$(node -e "import {readFileSync} from '"'node:fs'; const books = JSON.parse(readFileSync('/workspace/data/books.json','utf8')); console.log(books[books.length-1].id);\"); echo \"Book ID: "'$BOOK_ID"; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/$BOOK_ID | head -n 20; curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/$BOOK_ID/finish -i | head -n 20; kill $SERVER_PID; wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true'

/bin/bash -lc "cd /workspace && nl -ba server.js | sed -n '1,260p' && nl -ba lib/books-store.js | sed -n '1,260p' && nl -ba package.json && nl -ba public/styles.css | sed -n '1,260p' && nl -ba data/books.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cd /workspace && rg -n \"app.get\\('/'|app.post\\('/books'|app.post\\('/books/:id/finish'|app.get\\('/books/:id'|app.listen|function renderLayout|function renderBookItem|function renderBookList\" server.js && rg -n \"export async function listBooks|export async function getBookById|export async function addBook|export async function markBookFinished|async function loadBooks|async function saveBooks\" lib/books-store.js && rg -n \"\\\"start\\\"|\\\"express\\\"\" package.json"
